name: Pensar a Floresta que cria
description: This event is a conference titled "Pensar a Floresta que cria" (Thinking the Forest that Creates), part of the Festival Floresta Amazónica · Girando Mundos. Artists José Roberto Aguilar, Puwe, Sama, and João Boto will discuss the Amazon as a creative matrix and a territory of identity, knowledge, and responsibility.
longDescription:
The event "Pensar a Floresta que cria" is a conference held as part of the Festival Floresta Amazónica · Girando Mundos. It features a conversation moderated by cultural producer Axel Britto.

Artists José Roberto Aguilar, Puwe (from the Puyanawa indigenous people), Sama, and João Boto will share their perspectives on the Amazon. They will explore its influence on music, visual arts, and contemporary culture, considering it as a creative matrix and a territory of identity, knowledge, and responsibility.

The conference takes place on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 17:00 in the Blue Lounge of Casa da Música in Porto. Admission is free.
